name: Wynne Larson
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Wynne Larson supplies robes to mages across the kingdom. Since Dalaran and Quel'Thalas fell in the Third War, she relies on local craftsmen and points spellcasters toward rare materials for enchanted garments.

sections.title: A New Arcane Market
sections.body: Before the Third War, Dalaran and Quel'Thalas supplied the finest woven fabrics and enchanted vestments. Their destruction crippled the old trade routes and arcane textile making. Now Wynne Larson works with local tailors and enchanters such as Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Together, they meet the city's growing need for robes and spellwoven gear.

sections.title: Crafting Sorcerous Robes
sections.body: Novice and journeyman mages come to Wynne's shop for arcane garments. She knows what materials are needed for vestments such as Manaweave Robes and Astral Knot Garments. To find them, she sends spellcasters into dangerous places to recover rare reagents like pristine spider silk. Her work helps keep Stormwind's mages outfitted despite shortages from the north.

faq.q: Where can I find Wynne Larson?
faq.answer: You can find Wynne Larson in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter, where she sells arcane cloth chestpieces and garments to spellcasters.

faq.q: Why does Wynne mention Dalaran and Quel'Thalas?
aliases: why are robes hard to find
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Dalaran and Quel'Thalas were the Eastern Kingdoms' main sources of enchanted fabrics. Their destruction cut off imports, so Stormwind's merchants rely on local craftsmen and rare materials from farther afield.
Wynne helps mages obtain tailored arcane garments through Gathering Materials, Manaweave Robe, Pristine Spider Silk, and Astral Knot Garment.
Wynne sells basic and intermediate cloth robes, including Burning Robes, Chromatic Robes, Double-Stitched Robes, and Silver Dress Robes.

faq.q: Who does Wynne rely on for crafting supplies in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Wynne relies on local artisans, especially enchanter Lucan Cordell and other Stormwind tradesmen, to weave and enchant the goods she sells.

faq.q: Is Wynne Larson related to other Larsons in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Wynne shares her surname with Evan Larson, a Stormwind clothier, and Jenny Larson. The shared name suggests a family of tradesfolk in the city's garment trade.

angles.text: As a mage, you can turn to Wynne early in your arcane path for help tailoring Manaweave and Astral Knot garments.
As a tailor, you can see how clothiers and tailors help Stormwind after the northern textile centers fell.
As an Alliance member, you can see Stormwind stepping forward to provide self-sufficient arcane craftsmanship for the surviving Alliance races.
